items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we had a little band around Chicago, and we joined Art Tatum at the same time.

ctx.x: Me and Tatum and a saxophone player by the name of Scoops Carey. And we'd go and we'd hang out, in an after hours spot. And he'd drink this beer and let every piano player in town play before he sat down. And when he sat down to play he wiped everyone out, you know. But this is --
Did you play with him then (inaudible).
